saved_evidence.title: Proposed South Yale Metropolitan Redevelopment Area and Sector Development Plan Boundaries Map
saved_evidence.description: The City map draws the proposed South Yale metropolitan redevelopment area and sector development plan boundaries over the existing parcel zoning, labelling each parcel's R-1, R-2, R-3 or SU-2 designation across the corridor.
saved_evidence.evidence: Single-sheet PDF with a text layer of parcel labels, 540,797 bytes, filed as SyaleMapBnd.pdf. Titled "Proposed South Yale MRA/SDP Boundaries", with parcel-level zoning labels — R-1, R-2, R-3 and SU-2 — running along St Cyr, Dartmouth, Tulane, Basehart and Richmond.
saved_evidence.why_retained: The archive holds the South Yale transportation section, the complete street master plan, corridor segments and a segment concept plan, but no boundary map. It is the one sheet that shows what area all the other records cover.

cross_listings.reason: It is the area definition for the South Yale corridor records already published there.

saved_evidence.caution: Proposed boundaries, undated on its face. Do not present it as the adopted boundary.
